title: Chesapeake Gateway Chamber of Commerce holds 2025 Hometown Heroes Awards - NewsBreak
text:
By Chris Montcalmo ,
11 hours ago DUNDALK, MD—The Chesapeake Gateway Chamber of Commerce held its 2025 Hometown Heroes Awards ceremony on Wednesday evening.
Members of the organization gathered on November 18 at Sparrows Point Country Club to honor fire, police, military, hospital, and other local heroes who have shown courage in the face of a disaster or emergency.
Each of the honorees received a complimentary dinner, plaque, citations from local elected officials, and a gift bag.
This year’s honorees were as follows:
Volunteer Fire and Rescue Companies
Essex: EMS Lieutenant Cody Bussey Rosedale: EMT/Firefighter Charles McJilton Baltimore County Fire Department
Dundalk Station 6: Fire Captain Steven Czawlytko Fullerton Station 8: FADO (Fire Apparatus Driver/Operator) Zachary A. Belcher Parkville Station 10: EMT/Firefighter Nicholas Tawney Middle River Station 12: FADO (Fire Apparatus Driver/Operator) Michael Weil Baltimore County Police Department
Parkville Precinct 8: Sergeant George Bandurchin III Essex Precinct 11: Officer First Class Matthew Peters Dundalk Precinct 12: Lieutenant Benjamin Yohe Marine Team: Citizen Hero – Citizen Hero James Douglas Carter Maryland State Police—Golden Ring Barrack
Senior Trooper Zachary Adams Maryland Department of Natural Resources Police
Officer First Class Ryan Whittington Community College of Baltimore County
Certified Public Safety Officer Christopher Covington 175th Wing, Maryland Air National Guard
Firefighter William A. Frick 175th Infantry, Maryland Army National Guard
Captain Blake Thacker Johns Hopkins Bayview Medical Center
Clinical Nurse Natalie Schaeffler MedStar Franklin Square Medical Center
Physician & Board Member Howard Goldman, MD, MPH, FACP The stories and photos for each hero can be viewed in the event’s official program here (PDF) .
Photos via BCoFD and Councilman David Marks
